unlisted_practices: Head-to-head comparison of consumer chatbots on self-care recommendations for minor ailments, rated on accuracy, patient-centeredness, comprehensiveness and cosine similarity to standard recommendations

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, patient-centeredness, and comprehensiveness of LLMs (ChatGPT-4o mini, Gemini, Copilot) on 91 simulated minor ailment case scenarios compared to standard recommendations, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
